verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly is a hosted SaaS. The only self-hostable piece in evidence is the Relay Proxy, a small Go application you run on your own infrastructure (also described by the community as an open-source relay for resiliency). It caches and serves flag data to SDKs, but it still depends on the LaunchDarkly service and is not the core product, a dependency community commentary also notes. Missing for 10: a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core flag management platform (dashboard, API, targeting engine), self-hosting docs beyond the proxy, and evidence that it can run without the LaunchDarkly cloud.
